status: Approved research promotions from the Aug 24 deep adjacent-theme screen
note: Records below use the same core field shape as data/ideas.json so they can be merged into the monolithic idea universe without changing site code or scoring logic. Tactical watches are kept separate from core research promotions.

promotions.name: Belden
promotions.theme: Data-centre connectivity + industrial networking + physical AI
promotions.thesis: Differentiated physical-networking exposure spanning data-centre connectivity, industrial Ethernet and automation/physical-AI demand without requiring a single-chip or single-optical-component bet.
promotions.catalysts: AI/data-centre orders converting into backlog, industrial networking growth, RUCKUS integration and broader physical-AI deployment.
promotions.risks: RUCKUS integration, acquisition leverage, industrial-capex cyclicality and still-early disclosure of AI/data-centre revenue contribution.
promotions.researchNote: Best fresh US quality/valuation combination from the Aug 24 deep screen; record Q2 orders and 1.11 book-to-bill provide current commercial confirmation.

promotions.name: Generac
promotions.thesis: Hyperscaler backup-power demand turns reliability around constrained grids into a direct investable bottleneck rather than a theoretical adjacency.
promotions.catalysts: Conversion of roughly $1.6bn data-centre backlog, second hyperscale customer volumes and large-megawatt production expansion.
promotions.risks: Residential-generator cyclicality, capacity-ramp execution, capex requirements and normalization after the initial data-centre order surge.
promotions.researchNote: Strongest direct new backup-power/reliability candidate; keep below the GEV/PWR/ETN core until data-centre margins and delivery economics are clearer.

promotions.name: Amkor Technology
promotions.thesis: Advanced packaging and test capacity are becoming system-level AI infrastructure as HBM, accelerators and heterogeneous integration require scarce qualified assembly capacity.
promotions.catalysts: NVIDIA's $1.5bn multi-year advanced-packaging agreement/prepayment, TSMC's 10-year Arizona partnership and AI/HBM mix growth.
promotions.risks: Heavy capex, weak near-term free-cash-flow conversion, convertible-note dilution and semiconductor cyclicality.
promotions.researchNote: Best US HBM/advanced-packaging adjacency from the deep screen, but lower-ranked than BDC/GNRC in the current high-rate regime because financing and FCF risk are higher.

promotions.name: ASMPT
promotions.theme: HBM TCB/hybrid bonding + photonics + AI-server SMT
promotions.thesis: One listed equipment platform touches three emerging AI bottlenecks simultaneously: HBM advanced packaging, photonics/co-packaged-optics assembly and AI-server SMT manufacturing.
promotions.catalysts: HBM4/16H qualification and TCB orders, photonics/1.6T transceiver ramp, AI-server SMT bookings and strategic-review value realization.
promotions.risks: Demanding valuation, semiconductor-equipment cyclicality, CEO transition and execution around the SMT strategic-options review.
promotions.researchNote: Strongest genuinely new Hong Kong/China candidate from the Aug 24 screen; more differentiated than adding another broad China AI platform.

tacticalWatches.name: Scorpio Tankers
tacticalWatches.researchNote: Refined-product scarcity and rerouting are already visible in charter economics, but the current earnings regime is crisis-driven and should not be capitalised as a permanent compounder multiple.

tacticalWatches.name: COSCO Shipping Energy Transportation
tacticalWatches.researchNote: Useful China shipping expression of rerouted Gulf/Asia flows, but SOE governance, capital allocation and freight-rate cyclicality keep it below the core research queue.
